items.title: 10.2 Magnetic flux aur flux density (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2 with Figs. 10.5 to 10.9 and Example 10.2 (PDF 232-233).

blocks.text: Magnetic field ki taqat B ko hum lines of force se usi tarah zahir kar sakte hain jaise electric field ko. Tab field ke amudi sath se fi unit raqba guzarne wali in lines ki aabadi magnetic flux ko zahir karti hai.

blocks.title: Magnetic flux
blocks.text: Raqbe A ke tukre se magnetic flux us raqbe se guzarne wali magnetic lines ki tadaad hai. Agar B field ke amudi rakhe unit raqbe se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad zahir kare to B = phi/A ... (10.4).

Sath A field ke amudi na ho, yaani sath ka amud B se zawiya theta banaye (Fig. 10.5). Tab B ka vector area A ke saath juz (B cos theta) istemal karte hain (Fig. 10.6). Lihaza sath se guzarne wala flux phi_B = BA cos theta ... (10.5) hai. Chunke B aur A dono vectors hain, phi_B = B.A ... (10.6). Equation 10.6 dikhati hai ke phi_B scalar miqdar hai: yaksan magnetic field B mein raqbe A ke hamwar tukre se magnetic flux phi_B, B aur A ke dot product se milta hai.

blocks.alt: Ufuqi magenta field lines, B, daen taraf ek jhuke hue peele hamwar raqbe se guzarti hain. Raqbe se hara vector A, us ka amud (normal), field ki simt (dashed lakeer) se zawiya theta par oopar uthta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.5: Hamwar raqba A jis ka amud B se zawiya theta banata hai (kitab ki Figure 10.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Raqbe ka amud (normal) A, field B se theta zawiya banata hai. Jitni lines raqbe se guzarti hain woh raqbe ke us hisse par munhasir hain jo field ke amudi nazar aata hai, is liye flux = BA cos theta.

blocks.alt: Vector B ufuqi daen taraf; vector A usi nuqte se zawiya theta par oopar. B ke sire se A par amudi dashed lakeer; A par us nuqte tak ka hissa B cos theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: B ka vector area A ke saath juz B cos theta (kitab ki Figure 10.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: B ko do hisson mein torein: A ke saath wala hissa B cos theta aur A ke amudi hissa. Sirf A ke saath wala hissa raqbe se guzarta hai, is liye phi_B = (B cos theta) A = B.A.

A aisa vector hai jis ki miqdar tukre ka raqba aur simt tukre ki sath ke amud ke saath hai, aur theta vectors B aur A ki simton ka zawiya hai (Fig. 10.5). Fig. 10.7(a) mein field raqbe ke amud ke saath hai, to theta sifar (cos 0 = 1) aur flux zyada se zyada, BA ke barabar. Jab field raqbe ki satah ke mutawazi ho (Fig. 10.7b) to field aur amud ka zawiya 90 degrees (cos 90 = 0), to is rukh mein raqbe se flux sifar hai. Yaksan field mein kham-daar (curved) sath ko kai chhote tukron mein taqseem karte hain, har ek ko hamwar maan kar, aur poori sath ka flux Eq. 10.5 se tamam tukron ke hisson ka majmooa hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Peela raqba ufuqi field lines B ke aar paar khara hai aur hara vector A field ke saath hai. (b) Peela raqba field lines B ke saath leta hua hai aur A seedha oopar, B se 90 degrees par.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.7: (a) Field raqbe ke amud ke saath: flux zyada se zyada; (b) field raqbe ke mutawazi: flux sifar (kitab ki Figure 10.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein A aur B ek hi simt mein hain: theta = 0, cos 0 = 1, sab lines raqbe se guzarti hain, flux = BA. (b) mein raqba lines ke saath leta hai: A aur B ka zawiya 90 degrees, cos 90 = 0, koi line raqbe ko paar nahi karti, flux = 0.

blocks.title: Weber aur flux density
blocks.text: Tesla ki tareef se magnetic flux ki unit N m A^-1 hai, jise weber (Wb) kehte hain. Eq. 10.5 ke mutabiq magnetic induction B, B ke amudi sath ke fi unit raqbe ka flux hai; isi liye ise magnetic flux density bhi kehte hain, unit Wb m^-2. Lihaza magnetic field ki taqat Wb m^-2 ya N A^-1 m^-1 (tesla) mein napi jati hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.2
blocks.text: 25 cm lamba aur 20 cm chaura mustateel loop 1.2 T ki yaksan magnetic field mein rakha hai. Fig. 10.9 ke teen rukhon ke liye loop se magnetic flux nikalein, jahan loop field se 30, 45 aur 60 degrees banata hai. Hal: A = 20 cm x 25 cm = 5 x 10^-2 m^2. (a) B aur area vector A ka zawiya theta = 60 degrees: phi_B = BA cos theta = 1.2 T x 5 x 10^-2 m^2 x 0.5 = 3 x 10^-2 Wb. (b) theta = 45 degrees: phi_B = 1.2 x 5 x 10^-2 x 0.707 = 4.2 x 10^-2 Wb. (c) theta = 30 degrees: phi_B = 1.2 x 5 x 10^-2 x 0.866 = 5.2 x 10^-2 Wb.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse (a), (b), (c): har ek mein khari magenta field lines neeche ki taraf aur mustateel loop kinare se peeli patti ki tarah, field ki khari simt se 30, 45 aur 60 degrees par jhuka hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.8: Yaksan magnetic field mein mustateel loop ke teen rukh (Example 10.2) (kitab ki Figure 10.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Teenon rukhon ke liye loop ka kinara, seedha neeche vector B aur loop ke amudi area vector A. Loop B se 30, 45 aur 60 degrees banata hai, aur B aur A ka zawiya 60, 45 aur 30 degrees hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.9: Teenon rukhon mein B, loop aur area vector A ke zawiye (kitab ki Figure 10.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ahem baat: Fig. 10.8 mein likhe zawiye (30, 45, 60 degrees) loop aur field ke darmiyan hain, jabke formula mein theta B aur area vector A (loop ke amud) ka zawiya hai. Chunke A loop ke amudi hai, theta = 90 - (loop ka zawiya): 60, 45 aur 30 degrees. Isi liye (a) mein flux sab se kam aur (c) mein sab se zyada hai.

blocks.caption: Hamwar raqbe se flux
header: B aur amud ka zawiya theta

blocks.prompt: Magnetic flux aur flux density mein farq bataiye. In ka aapas mein kya rishta hai (comprehensive question 10.1)? Coil se flux ke liye magnetic field zaroori hai, magar field hone se coil se flux zaroori nahi; wazahat kijiye (short question 10.9).
blocks.explanation: Flux phi_B = B.A scalar hai, kisi raqbe se guzarti field lines ki tadaad, webers mein; flux density B vector hai, field ke amudi rakhi sath se fi unit raqba flux, Wb m^-2 (tesla) mein; rishta phi_B = BA cos theta, ya amudi raqbe ke liye B = phi/A. Agar coil ki satah field ke saath lete ho to B aur amud ka zawiya 90 degrees aur cos 90 = 0, to field maujood hone ke bawajood coil se koi flux nahi guzarta.

items: Magnetic flux: raqbe se guzarti field lines ki tadaad; B = phi/A (10.4); phi_B = BA cos theta (10.5) = B.A (10.6), scalar; raqba field ki taraf ho to zyada se zyada, saath lete to sifar; kham-daar sath chhote hamwar tukron mein.
Flux ki unit weber, 1 Wb = 1 N m A^-1; B flux density hai, 1 T = 1 Wb m^-2 = 1 N A^-1 m^-1. Example 10.2: 3.0, 4.2 aur 5.2 x 10^-2 Wb.
